scientific.integrity: The proof reconstructs the degree-two Mumford--Tate invariants from the source's product classification and checks the sharp examples from the source's symmetric-power construction. The primary ownership is recorded only at MSC section 14, matching the source's explicit primary Algebraic Geometry classification; no finer MSC code is asserted.
limitations: The statement is restricted to non-isotrivial Lagrangian fibrations.
It concerns very general smooth closed complex fibers, not the scheme-theoretic generic fiber.
Sharp attainability for every divisor uses primitive symplectic varieties and may use singular total spaces; the smooth hyper-Kähler intermediate cases remain open.

title: Picard numbers of very general Lagrangian fibers are exactly the divisors of the fiber dimension
